changeSummary: Set singlePeerConnection: false in Room constructor options literal

diff.before: const room = new Room({ webAudioMix: false, adaptiveStream: true, dynacast: true });
diff.after: const room = new Room({ webAudioMix: false, adaptiveStream: true, dynacast: true, singlePeerConnection: false });

tradeoffs.negotiation: Subscriber PC is server-offered; eliminates client-side SDP offer generation and queuing delay during track selection switch
tradeoffs.cpu: Slight reduction in transient client CPU during track selection switches
tradeoffs.memory: Approximately 1-2 MB additional browser heap per tab for the second RTCPeerConnection instance

disclaimers.unitTestLimitation: livekit-client is mocked in DOM tests; headed run required to verify dual PC network behavior
